text.text: Plan study blocks backwards from each exam, then review flashcards in boxes: miss a card and it returns to box 1, nail it and it moves up.
Today's study
Exam countdown
Plan
Flashcards
This page reads live from your tables. Use it for the weekly check, then open the table behind any number to act on it.
Weak spots
Low confidence sessions
How to read this page
The charts count rows by the groups shown; click through to see which rows they are.
The lists below show only the rows that need attention now.
If a chart looks wrong, check that the linked column on the rows is filled in.
A simple spaced-review routine.
Each day, review every card in box 1, and the cards due from higher boxes.
Got it right: move it up one box and set Last reviewed to today.
Got it wrong: move it back to box 1.
Box 5 cards need a look only once every few weeks.
Mark Known when you could explain the answer without looking.
Why boxes work

Cards you know move to a higher box and come back less often; cards you miss drop to box 1 and return tomorrow. The Review column compares days since the last review with the interval for the card's box.
A ten-minute session
Open the cards where Review says Due.
Say the answer out loud before you flip.
Press Got it or Missed.
Stop after ten minutes; come back tomorrow.
Admission ticket or student ID

Water and a snack

One page of formulae read, then put away
Read the whole paper before writing anything.
Night before
Skim the summary sheets once, then stop
Lay out ID, pens and water
Sleep matters more than another hour of review
After the exam
Write down which topics came up. Add them to the next subject's plan.
